stemMd: Which inference is supported by the revised results?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every initial reading was mechanically inaccurate.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Dense development has been proved to have no thermal effect.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Canopies increase every pedestrian’s heat exposure.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Some of the initial contrast was associated with differences in sensor placement.

explanationMd: The contrast shrinks after comparable placement, which supports a role for measurement design without proving the entire pattern was artefactual.

distractorRationale.e: The passage says differences still exist.
distractorRationale.a: Local readings were accepted as accurate.
distractorRationale.c: The direction and universal scope are unsupported.
distractorRationale.b: The revised evidence does not establish that universal causal conclusion.
